An '''Imperial official''' was present within the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fighter group [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]&mdash;led by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]&mdash;was spotted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] while trying to infiltrate a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility within the [[Star system/Legends|system]], this Imperial hailed them and demanded their immediate surrender. This [[Gender/Legends|man]] knew that the Rebels were in the system and he promised to show them mercy.
